goal: R35 — the founder said «the language is weak» and handed over his own approved WhatsApp template as the register standard; mid-round he added «make the UI better» with a screenshot of the product page. What he actually wants: every Arabic string in Massar to read as if HE wrote it (enterprise plural address, verb-led value statements, precise sector terms, one word per concept, no marketing tone), the Cairo font, «محادثات خارج الحملات» gone, the portal to stop churning every 5 seconds, and the product page to read as ONE record instead of scattered cards.
headline: Four of the five asks are done and verified, and the product-page rebuild is a genuine, visible win — his exact composition complaint is fixed. The core ask, the language, is still not done: 232 of 462 strings were applied and the ~230 skipped as «markup/interpolation» were never proofread. Every language defect in this review lives in that skipped bucket. Two blockers are new this round: the scoreboard's divider rule is drawn on the wrong logical edge (verified in code and by eye at all three viewports), and the working tree carries 435 uncommitted lines that duplicate the entire KB block — a live hazard because `fly deploy` is pre-authorized.

per_demand_disposition.demand: 1. «The language is weak» — assign Codex to rewrite the Arabic to the founder's own template register
what_landed: src/agent.ts system prompt now reads as a professional sales playbook: «# الهوية وأسلوب التواصل / # إدارة مسار المحادثة / # تقديم القيمة التشغيلية / # ضوابط التواصل», with «خاطب ممثل المنشأة بصيغة الجمع المهنية» and «لا تستخدم الرموز التعبيرية أو العبارات الزخرفية» as explicit standing rules.

All six PRODUCTS pitches were rebuilt on his own verb: «يُمكّن منشأتكم من إصدار الإجازات المرضية وإدارتها إلكترونيًا، بتوثيق رسمي وتكامل مباشر مع HIS وERP، والتفعيل خلال 5 أيام عمل.» — verb-led, plural, operational, zero adjectives. Indistinguishable from the template.
His three-part structure is encoded as a rule, not a sentence: «ابدأ بالقيمة التشغيلية، ثم اشرح آليتها» (agent.ts:193).
src/insights.ts analyst prompt and LOSS_TAXONOMY are precise and evidence-bound; the campaign-detail screen is the best Arabic in the product.
A reusable 22-term glossary + 462-entry copy-map + strings-inventory now exist as auditable, re-runnable artifacts.
what_is_missing: Terminology discipline fails on the screens he opens first: «منتج» beats the canonical «الخدمة» 25-to-9 on the served page; «الجمهور» / «العميل» / «قائمة المستهدفين» / «جهات الاستهداف» name ONE collection four ways; the won/lost pair is now named THREE ways («مكتسبة/غير مكتسبة» in DEAL_META, «مكتسبة/خاسرة» in the win-loss chips, «صفقات مكتملة/لم تُغلق» on the new product page); «ساندبوكس» survives beside «البيئة التجريبية».

Two outright wrong words shipped: «الأرقام تتحدّث لحظيًا» and «العدد يتحدّث فورًا» — تحدّث means to SPEAK; the intended root is تحديث. «العدد يتحدّث فورًا» literally reads «the count speaks immediately».
VOICE-REFERENCE.md line 41 names «ما يستحق وقتك الآن» and «افتح ←» as the casual strings needing review. Both still ship on the home screen at this commit.

per_demand_disposition.evidence: dashboard.ts dataSignature() + render(fetchNew): a poll whose signature is unchanged calls stamp() and returns, so only the clock repaints. I traced every operator-critical mutation to a signature term rather than trusting the comment: new contact → cs.length; inbound/agent/system message → transcript sum; delivery status sent→delivered→read→replied → statusTimes key count (each adds a key); interest tag → tags length; human takeover → `c.human?1:0`; sandbox flag → `c.test?2:0`; the four human outcome buttons → /admin/contact/outcome calls tracker.recordSystem (index.ts:292), which appends a transcript line; new campaign/entity/KB doc/asset → their .length; deal-state changes → JSON.stringify(winloss.totals); every view control is in the signature verbatim. render(false) — hashchange and refreshInsights — bypasses the gate, so explicit navigation always repaints. countUp() is separately guarded by _countedValues so KPI digits no longer re-animate each tick. Residual staleness is narrow and self-healing (N19).

per_demand_disposition.demand: 5. «Make the UI better» (+ screenshot of the product page) — 96c491d, 8a599dc
what_landed: His composition complaint is genuinely fixed. The hero now carries identity tile + service name + status chips + the 92% readiness ring + the primary «أطلق حملة بهذه الخدمة ←» CTA on ONE row, terminating in the action — the name no longer sits alone in one card with the number floating in another and the CTA stranded across a whitespace canyon.

The four verdict chips became one scoreboard with tabular numerals and a footer band carrying «أبرز سبب لعدم الإغلاق: التوقيت» plus this service's campaign chips. Related information now sits together.
8a599dc does its job: campaign chips truncate with ellipsis + a full-name `title` attribute — «اختبار الرسالة المضمنة — ملف...» instead of a mid-word cut. Verified at 1440 and 768.

The full-width dashed blocks are gone, replaced by two compact icon-tile file rows under «ملفات الخدمة / ما يرسله المساعد للعميل، وما يقرأه ليبيع» — one of the best lines in the product: two jobs, parallel, eight words.

Discoverability of the merged inputs is FINE, and arguably better than before: each row pairs a state chip with a ghost button («مرفق» + «استبدال», «مطلوب» + «رفع الملف»), so the state tells you whether action is needed and the button says what it does. Both `pafile` and `kbfile` are created inside the same view that calls them.

RTL is correct: the scoreboard uses the logical `border-inline-end` property rather than a physical side, the breadcrumb and text align right, the CTA terminates at the left, and the ring's `stroke-dasharray` factor (0.974) is the true circumference ratio for r=15.5.
Mobile stacking at 375 is good: hero collapses to tile → name → chips → ring → full-width CTA in correct reading order; the scoreboard becomes a clean 2×2.
blockers: M7 — the scoreboard divider is drawn on the wrong logical edge, so the composition the commit exists to deliver is visibly broken at every viewport (see the grill's design_ux lens for the full derivation).
M8 — the working tree carries 435 uncommitted lines duplicating the whole KB block.
per_demand_disposition.regression_check_requested_by_orchestrat: Ran it against the COMMITTED tree, not the working tree. (a) `kbstat`/`pastat` are NOT dangling: both are created at dashboard.ts:1019 inside vKbProduct, and the handlers that look them up (paUpload :874, kbUpload :891) are only reachable from `paPick()`/`kbPick()` at :1013/:1016 — same view, same DOM. No null dereference on any path I could trace. (b) `uploadZone()` IS orphaned: `grep -c uploadZone` on `git show 8a599dc:src/dashboard.ts` returns 1 — the definition, zero call sites. It survives as dead code shipped to every client. tsc cannot see it because it lives inside the client-JS template literal, which is why `npm run build` stays green (verified: exits 0). (c) A consequence neither commit message mentions: `uploadZone(null)` was the ONLY unscoped upload path, and `kbRegistry()` composes the registry from the six seeded PRODUCTS plus any kbDoc whose product name is not already present — so with vKb() no longer rendering it, there is no UI path left to ADD a new service. Removing the LIST-screen dropzone is right and matches his own R15-era correction that uploads live only inside product pages (b66bce0); losing the create-a-service path is a side effect that needs a decision (S17).

The campaigns table does not: an identity column that ellipsizes 3 of 5 rows while «الحالة» holds slack, and rate columns labelled with bare nouns («مشاهدة» over a 100% value), are exactly the «works but looks like an admin script» failures he rejects.

user-model Rule 2 (numbers real, sourced, honestly bounded): the honest captions survived and are good, but the flagship honesty caption is the one carrying the wrong word — «الأرقام تتحدّث لحظيًا» — so the sentence he values most is the sentence that misfires. The new scoreboard also shows honest zeros («صفقات مكتملة 0») rather than hiding an empty state.

user-model Rule 3 (briefs by concrete reference artifact; adopt the PATTERN, not the paint): VOICE-REFERENCE.md is the purest instance of this rule yet — he supplied his own template as the spec — and the product-page screenshot is the same rule applied to layout. Rule 3 means the extracted RULES get applied everywhere; the template landed as the default campaign message (correct) while its rules stopped at the strings the tool could safely regex.

grill.method: Judged as a native Saudi B2B reader against VOICE-REFERENCE.md, not against the diff. Strong strings quoted first so the finding is calibrated, not reflexive.
strongest_strings: «يُمكّن منشأتكم من إصدار الإجازات المرضية وإدارتها إلكترونيًا، بتوثيق رسمي وتكامل مباشر مع HIS وERP، والتفعيل خلال 5 أيام عمل.» (agent.ts:68) — his verb, his plural, his operational concreteness.
«حكم الحملة: أُرسلت، وبانتظار الردّ الأول.» — factual, verb-led, no hype, admits the state honestly.
«أعد استهداف ٤ جهة شاهدت دون ردّ» / «الاهتمام قائم، وأثر الرسالة غير واضح» — القيمة→الآلية→الخطوة compressed into a next-move card.
«ملفات الخدمة / ما يرسله المساعد للعميل، وما يقرأه ليبيع» (new product page) — two jobs, parallel, eight words. Best new line this round.
«أطلق حملة بهذه الخدمة ←» — verb-led, glossary-correct, and it NAMES its destination. This is exactly the pattern «افتح ←» should adopt; the fix already exists in the codebase.
«ابدأ بالقيمة التشغيلية، ثم اشرح آليتها» (agent.ts:193) — his structure as a standing rule, not a one-off sentence.
«حكم الصفقة · نية الشراء · القناة المفضلة · وقت التواصل» — four parallel two-word nominal labels; exactly the UI discipline the reference asks for.
«ينقصه: · مطابقة مع جهة استهداف مستوردة · بيانات التصنيف (المدينة/الحجم/القطاع)» — honest, specific, no padding.

findings.finding: WRONG WORD, twice: «الأرقام تتحدّث لحظيًا من حالات تسليم واتساب — لا تقديرات» (dashboard.ts:517) and «العدد يتحدّث فورًا.» (:781). تحدّث = to speak; تحديث = to update. «العدد يتحدّث فورًا» reads «the count speaks immediately». Both sit in the skipped-for-markup bucket.

TERMINOLOGY: «الخدمة» loses to «منتج» 9-to-25 on the served page — the campaigns table header «المنتج» (:495), the CSV export header (:523), wizard step 1 «أي منتج يبيعه المساعد؟», the KB list «منتجات المساعد · N منتج · اضغط منتجًا…» (:934), and agent.ts:204/244 where the tool description says «asset_id = اسم الخدمة» while its own parameter description says «اسم المنتج». The new product page makes this sharper, not softer: it is correctly and consistently «الخدمة» throughout («كل الخدمات», «حملات الخدمة», «ملفات الخدمة», «الخدمة غير موجودة»), and its own «→ كل الخدمات» link lands on a page headed «منتجات المساعد». The collision is now inside one module, one click apart.

TERMINOLOGY: one collection, four names. The customers route shows nav «العملاء» + title «قائمة المستهدفين» + subtitle «استورد جهات الاستهداف…» in a single viewport (:269); the campaigns table calls the same quantity «الجمهور» (:495, :523); the campaign-detail contact table heads its rows «العميل» about 40px under a section header reading «جهات الاستهداف ٤ من ٤». «الجمهور» is also the exact marketing register his template avoids.

TERMINOLOGY: won/lost is now named THREE ways. DEAL_META says «صفقة مكتسبة» / «غير مكتسبة» (:1248); the win-loss panel and chips say «مكتسبة» / «خاسرة» (:1299, :1315); the new product-page scoreboard introduces «صفقات مكتملة» / «لم تُغلق» (:985-986). «مكتملة» is also semantically wrong for `won` — a lost deal is equally completed — so «صفقات مكتملة 0» sitting beside «لم تُغلق 1» reads as a contradiction rather than a scoreboard.

VOICE-REFERENCE.md line 41 names «ما يستحق وقتك الآن» and «افتح ←» as the casual strings needing review against this bar. Both ship unchanged, on the home screen, along with their sibling «ما الذي يحدث الآن في السوق — ومن يستحق اتصالك اليوم».

The four outcome buttons rest their meaning on an invisible diacritic: «حُجز اجتماع» / «أُرسل العرض» (:1364) are correct passives in source, but at button size in Cairo the damma is not legible — I could not resolve it at full capture resolution — so they read as «حجز اجتماع» and, worse, «أرسل العرض» (imperative: send the offer). A ledger-writing button that reads like an outbound command is a hazard in a product whose §8 rule is that nothing goes out without a human checkpoint. Same class as the wordmark fatha, which the team correctly fixed by removing the diacritic dependency.

«ساندبوكس» (×3, incl. the campaign-launch sticky bar) survives beside the canonical «البيئة التجريبية». Same class: «المنتجات المدمجة» (wizard step 1) and «المعرفة الأساسية المدمجة» (product page) are calques for built-in.

Address is mixed in the operator UI. The reference allows operator brevity, not incoherence: «ارفع ملفك», «من أعمدة ملفك», «قائمتك كما هي», «موافقتك البشرية», «ويصلك تنبيه», «اتصالك», «اضغط أي حملة», «اختر شريحة كاملة أو حدّد جهات بعينها» sit beside fully plural customer copy.

agent.ts:190 «استخدم صيغة جمع مهنية، أو الاسم الأول للشخص عند توفره» — the «أو» licenses dropping the plural whenever a first name exists. The pre-rewrite transcripts in copy-profile.png show exactly that drift inside one sentence: «شكرًا لوقتك. أحطتُ ملاحظتك للمختص ليشرح الربط مع نظامكم بوضوح عند رغبتكم.» — singular and plural in nine words. The new prompt does not close the door that produced it.
Typo, agent.ts:98: «ننّفذ الإجراءات يدويًا حاليًا» — the shadda sits on the first ن instead of the ف. Correct: «ننفّذ». Verified at the codepoint level (NOON, NOON, SHADDA, FEH, THAL).

Parallelism: insights.ts:57 «ردّ على حملة» and :60 «استلم الملف التعريفي» are verb phrases among six nominal siblings; LOSS_TAXONOMY's «لا استجابة» breaks the «عدم …» pattern of its neighbours and «طلب التواصل مع مختص» drops the glossary's «مختص المبيعات». On the new scoreboard the four cells are four different shapes: «حملات الخدمة» (noun phrase) · «صفقات مكتملة» (noun+adj) · «لم تُغلق» (negated verb clause) · «قيد التفاوض» (prepositional).

grill.evidence: Health-sector register is genuinely right: الممارسين · المنشأة · التفعيل · المتطلبات التقنية · التكامل · HIS/ERP · NVR used accurately, pricing bounded («يحدده المختص وفق الحجم»), and the loss taxonomy speaks his market. The founder's template is reproduced verbatim as campMsg with {product} substituted for {{1}} and the «حلول تكامل للقطاع الصحي» footer present in the preview — both confirmed on the live page. The product page's «أبرز سبب لعدم الإغلاق: التوقيت» correctly surfaces this service's dominant loss cause from real cached reads.

findings.finding: Mixed numeral systems on the same screen. 13 call sites use toLocaleString("ar-SA") (Arabic-Indic ٠١٢٣) and 6 use "ar-SA-u-nu-latn" (Latin), plus toLocaleTimeString("ar-SA"). On copy-kmondet.png a stat card reads «4» while its own filter chip directly beneath reads «(٤)» for the same count; the home KPIs are Latin while the chart axis and clock are Arabic-Indic.

Two different notions of «معرفة» on the product page report opposite states at once: the ring says «92% جاهزية معرفة المساعد» (from the seeded score `r.sc`) while the chip says «بانتظار ملف المعرفة» and the file row says «مطلوب» (from `r.hub`, the uploaded doc). A reader cannot tell whether this service is ready. Either label the ring for what it measures («جاهزية المعرفة المدمجة») or drive both from the same signal.

Rate columns named as bare nouns: the campaigns table heads two percentage columns «مشاهدة» and «ردود» (:495) while the campaign-detail screen one click away calls the same metrics «نسبة المشاهدة» and «نسبة الردود». The CSV export (:523) introduces a third set («وصلت», «شوهدت», «ردّوا»).

grill.evidence: No §8 boundary touched. The change is copy + font + a client-side render gate + a view rebuild; zero outbound sends were made during this review (read-only GET /health and GET /dashboard only). The opt-out path is intact and untouched — OPT_OUT_BARE/EXPLICIT/PROXIMITY/NEGATION/EN all present at agent.ts:395-411 with the tashkeel-stripping normalizer, and the reply «تم إيقاف الرسائل. شكرًا لوقتكم، ونعتذر عن الإزعاج.» is correctly plural. Webhook token auth and admin gating untouched (index.ts:285 adminOk). No secret appears in the diff or this envelope. `fly deploy` is pre-authorized by the standing instruction of Aug 10 — which is precisely why M8 (dirty working tree) is filed as a must rather than housekeeping.

The rewrite and the rebuild both respect the existing IA — nav groups, screen map and the campaigns-as-launches model are unchanged. Two product decisions are right and worth naming: making the founder's template the DEFAULT campaign message (not a sample) puts his voice at the start of every launch; and confining uploads to product pages matches his own R15-era correction (b66bce0).

findings.finding: There is no longer any UI path to ADD a new service. `uploadZone(null)` — «أضف خدمة مع ملفها … يُستخرج اسم المنتج من الملف تلقائيًا» — was the only unscoped upload, and `kbRegistry()` builds the list from the six seeded PRODUCTS plus any kbDoc whose product name is not already present. With vKb() no longer rendering it, the portal can only manage the six hardcoded services. Decide explicitly: either restore a compact «أضف خدمة» action on the list header, or state that services are seeded-only for now.

The nav still carries both «معرفة الخدمة» (under التسويق) and «المنتجات» (under التخطيط وقياس الأداء) — the terminology collision is baked into the primary navigation, so body-copy fixes cannot fully resolve it until the nav picks one concept name.

Double titling: the top bar renders «الحملات / متابعة أداء حملات مساعد المبيعات» and the page immediately repeats «الحملات / كل إطلاق، أرقامه الفعلية، ونتيجته…». The product page handles this better — the top bar keeps the module name and the h1 carries the service — so the good pattern already exists.

grill.evidence: Walked all eight captured screens. RTL is correct throughout — sidebar right, mirrored layout, right-aligned text, toggles on the correct edge, and the LTR-forced funnel SVG and phone numbers properly scoped with dir="ltr". The product page uses the logical `border-inline-end` rather than a physical side (right instinct), its ring `stroke-dasharray` factor 0.974 is the true circumference ratio for r=15.5, and the file rows pair a state chip with a ghost button so the merged `pafile`/`kbfile` inputs read as discoverable actions. Mobile stacking at 375 is correct and pleasant. Empty/loading/error/learning/degraded states are all present and honest.

findings.finding: The scoreboard divider is on the wrong logical edge — dashboard.ts:991 `(i ? "border-inline-end:1px solid #EAECF0;" : "")`. In RTL, `border-inline-end` is the element's LEFT side, so the rule for cell i lands between cells i and i+1 — one boundary too far. Derived from the geometry (card ~1110px, 4 columns of ~277px, cell 0 rightmost) and then confirmed by measuring all three captures: at 1440 the rules land at x≈588, ≈311 and ≈33, i.e. between cells 1|2 and 2|3 plus a stray rule flush on the card's outer left edge, with NO rule between «حملات الخدمة» and «صفقات مكتملة» — so the two rightmost cells read as one double-wide compartment. Identical at 768 (rules at ≈386, ≈208, ≈33; nothing between the first two cells). At 375 the 2×2 grid additionally has no horizontal rule between rows, so it reads as a loose cluster. Fix: `border-inline-start` (cell i's leading edge = the i-1|i boundary, and nothing on the outer edge). One token, and it is the difference between «one scoreboard» and what the commit actually ships.

Campaign identity truncates while low-information columns hold slack: on copy-kmon.png 3 of 5 campaign names are ellipsized («إثبات — الملف والنص في رسالة …», «اختبار الرسالة المضمنة — ملف + …», «حملة تجريبية — نظام الحملات ال…») while «الحالة» and the service column sit half-empty. The operator cannot tell two launches apart on the primary screen. Note the product page already solved this correctly in 8a599dc with ellipsis + `title` — apply the same treatment.

Decorative emoji returned to operator chips: «ملف تعريفي 📎» (×2), «الملف مضمّن 📎», «🔔 تنبيهات «عميل جاد» و«طلب تدخّل»…». The chip text already says what it is; R27 rejected exactly this pattern. ✓ and ✕ are functional glyphs and stay.

At 768 the scoreboard footer band wraps its third campaign chip to a new line, which in RTL starts at the right — under the loss cause — while chips 1-2 sit left on line 1, so the reading order zig-zags. A `justify-content` on the chip group, or capping at two chips below 900px, settles it.
Nested identical guillemets: «…تظهر «فشل الإرسال» بشفافية» and «قال: «طيب لا داعي، شكرًا»». Arabic typography wants a different inner mark or none.

Home KPI label parallelism: «جهات الاستهداف» (2 words) · «ردّوا» (1) · «وصلت الرسائل إلى الجهات» (4, a clause) · «جهات مهتمة ومؤهلة» (3) · «الحملات الفعلية» (2). The clause is the outlier against the reference's 1–3 word rule.

grill.evidence: The render gate is the right shape: a pure function of cache + view state, compared before any DOM write, with the clock deliberately outside the gate and focus/selection preserved across repaints. The product-page rebuild is a pure view change — no new endpoint, no new state, no new dependency — and it correctly reuses existing data (`campaigns`, `winloss.by_product`, `winloss.loss_causes`, `prodAssets`, `kbRegistry`) rather than adding a fetch. The strings-inventory + copy-map artifacts make the rewrite auditable and re-runnable, which is the right boring-tech answer to «rewrite 462 strings». Build is green (`npm run build` → tsc exits 0).

findings.finding: The working tree is dirty in a way that would ship: `git status` reports ` M src/dashboard.ts`, and the working file is 2013 lines against 1578 at HEAD — 435 uncommitted lines that DUPLICATE the entire KB block, with `kbRegistry`, `uploadZone` and `vKb` each defined twice locally (910/1298, 916/1304, 924/1312) versus exactly once in the commit. In browser JS the later definition silently wins, so a `fly deploy` from this tree — pre-authorized, no human gate — would ship different behaviour than the reviewed commit, and neither tsc (the block lives inside the client-JS template literal) nor the delivery gate (it binds to a commit) can see it. I confirmed the LIVE payload is currently clean: one copy of each function, 139,793 bytes, «أطلق حملة بهذه الخدمة» present. So this is a live hazard, not a live defect. Resolve before the next deploy: either commit the intended change or `git checkout -- src/dashboard.ts`.

`uploadZone()` is dead code shipped to every client: `grep -c uploadZone` on `git show 8a599dc:src/dashboard.ts` returns 1 — the definition, zero call sites. Invisible to tsc for the same template-literal reason. Delete it (and see the product lens on the create-a-service path it used to carry).

dataSignature() hashes COUNTS and identity, not content, for three sources: winloss beyond `.totals`, cached insights beyond `Object.keys(insCache).length`, and campaign rows beyond `campaigns.length`. A re-read that changes a loss cause or a next action without changing any count or the totals will not repaint. Narrow and self-healing (any inbound message or status callback moves the transcript/status sum), which is why it is `nice` — but it is the one way this gate can show stale data. The contact term is also a summed scalar, so an increment and a decrement in the same tick could cancel (two operators, or two tabs); a joined per-contact string removes the class.

grill.evidence: Hunted by name. No placeholder or lorem copy, no fake data presented as real (test traffic is explicitly «تجريبية» and excluded from default KPIs), no dead buttons on the paths I traced (every outcome button posts; every chip filters; both file-row buttons reach a live input), no TODO stubs, no purple-gradient genericism — the palette is the navy/teal/gold system and the product page's gradient identity tile uses the brand navy. The honest captions are specific rather than hedged, and «قيد التعلّم» / «قراءة المساعد غير متاحة مؤقتًا» tell the truth instead of showing an invented number.

findings.finding: Dead code shipped: `uploadZone()` (see system_design). Its own body also still contains the only «أضف خدمة مع ملفها» string in the product — copy for a feature no user can reach.

Stale narrating comment shipped as documentation: agent.ts:9-15 still describes the persona as «consultative closer (confident, warm, momentum-driven), MSA Arabic, short messages, light emoji» — «light emoji» is now directly contradicted by the prompt it documents («لا تستخدم الرموز التعبيرية»). It is the first thing the next engineer reads.
«ما الذي يحدث الآن في السوق» is a rhetorical-question headline over a 9-contact sandbox — grander than the data behind it, and his register is declarative, not rhetorical.

score_rationale.intent_fidelity: 7 — four of five asks are cleanly and verifiably done, and the product-page rebuild answers his composition complaint point for point. But his headline ask was THE LANGUAGE, and the screens he opens first still contradict the glossary, still carry the two strings his own reference names, and still contain two wrong words.
score_rationale.completeness: 6 — 232 of 462 entries applied; the ~230 skipped as markup/interpolation were never proofread by any pass, and every language defect in this review was found inside that bucket. On the UI side the new page ships with its scoreboard rules misdrawn at all three viewports and a 435-line uncommitted duplication in the tree.
score_rationale.coherence: 6 — four names for one collection, three for one deal state (the new page added the third), two numeral systems, and a nav carrying both «معرفة الخدمة» and «المنتجات». Coherence is exactly what a glossary buys, and it was not bought. The product page is internally coherent, which makes the contrast with the list page it links to sharper.
score_rationale.taste: 8 — the campaign-detail screen, the product pitches, the insights panel labels, the honest captions and now the product-page hero/file-rows are at his bar and would survive his review unedited.
score_rationale.surprise: 5 — the reusable glossary + copy-map + strings-inventory are a durable asset beyond the ask, and the ellipsis+title treatment on the campaign chips is the right instinct applied without being asked; nothing else unrequested landed.

change_orders.order: Fix the two wrong words. dashboard.ts:517 «الأرقام تتحدّث لحظيًا من حالات تسليم واتساب — لا تقديرات» → «تُحدَّث الأرقام لحظيًا من حالات تسليم واتساب — لا تقديرات». dashboard.ts:781 «العدد يتحدّث فورًا.» → «يُحدَّث العدد فورًا.» (تحدّث = to speak; the intended root is تحديث.)

Enforce product = «الخدمة» everywhere, then grep to zero. dashboard.ts:495 header «المنتج» → «الخدمة»; :523 CSV header «المنتج» → «الخدمة»; wizard step 1 «أي منتج يبيعه المساعد؟» → «أي خدمة يعرضها المساعد؟» and «القائمة تشمل منتجات Product Hub المرفوعة بملفاتها — لا تقتصر على المنتجات المدمجة.» → «تشمل القائمة خدمات Product Hub المرفوعة بملفاتها، ولا تقتصر على الخدمات المُعرَّفة مسبقًا.»; :934 «منتجات المساعد … N منتج · اضغط منتجًا لعرض معرفته وإدارتها» → «خدمات المساعد … N خدمة · افتح الخدمة لعرض معرفتها وإدارتها»; agent.ts:204 «متاح لهذه المنتجات … (باسم المنتج) … الحديث عن المنتج» → الخدمات/الخدمة; agent.ts:244 parameter description «اسم المنتج» → «اسم الخدمة» (it currently contradicts its own tool description at :243); agent.ts:320 lead card «المنتج:» → «الخدمة:». The new product page is already correct — match it. Acceptance: grep for «منتج» on the served /dashboard returns 0 outside the literal brand string «Product Hub».

One name for the targeted-contact collection. Pick «جهات الاستهداف» (the glossary term, already the most used) and apply it to: :269 title «قائمة المستهدفين» → «جهات الاستهداف»; :495 and :523 column «الجمهور» → «جهات الاستهداف»; the campaign-detail contact table header «العميل» → «جهة الاستهداف»; the link text at :790 and :1333 → the same name; and the nav — either rename «العملاء» to match or keep «العملاء» as the module and make the page title match the nav, but do not ship three names in one viewport. Fold the duplicate nav entry «المنتجات» into «معرفة الخدمة».

One pair of words for won/lost, used in all three places. Adopt the glossary: won = «صفقة مكتسبة», lost = «غير مكتسبة». dashboard.ts:1299 «كل صفقة مكتسبة أو خاسرة» → «… أو غير مكتسبة»; :1315 chip «N خاسرة» → «N غير مكتسبة»; and the new scoreboard :985-986 «صفقات مكتملة» → «صفقات مكتسبة», «لم تُغلق» → «غير مكتسبة». «مكتملة» is not just off-glossary, it is wrong — a lost deal is also completed, so «صفقات مكتملة 0» beside «لم تُغلق 1» reads as a contradiction.

Retire the three strings VOICE-REFERENCE.md flags. Home H3 «ما يستحق وقتك الآن» → «ما يستحق المتابعة الآن»; both «افتح ←» CTAs → name the destination, following the pattern the new product page already uses («أطلق حملة بهذه الخدمة ←») and the existing «المحادثة ←» — i.e. «معرفة الخدمة ←» on the KB card and «لوحة الحملة ←» on the next-move card; home subtitle «ما الذي يحدث الآن في السوق — ومن يستحق اتصالك اليوم» → «نشاط الحملات الآن، والجهات التي تستحق المتابعة اليوم».

Remove the diacritic dependency from the four outcome buttons. dashboard.ts:1364 «حُجز اجتماع» / «أُرسل العرض» / «مؤجل» / «غير مناسب» → «اجتماع محجوز» / «عرض مُرسَل» / «مؤجل» / «غير مناسب». At button size in Cairo the damma is not legible, so «أُرسل العرض» reads as the imperative «send the offer» on a button that only writes to the ledger. The four labels also become parallel nominals. If any tashkeel is retained it must be legible at the rendered size — the same lesson as the wordmark fatha.

Fix the scoreboard divider edge. dashboard.ts:991 `(i ? "border-inline-end:1px solid #EAECF0;" : "")` → `(i ? "border-inline-start:1px solid #EAECF0;" : "")`. In RTL, border-inline-end is the element's LEFT side, so every rule lands one boundary too far: verified at 1440 and 768 that there is NO rule between «حملات الخدمة» and «صفقات مكتملة» (they read as one double-wide cell) while a stray rule sits flush on the card's outer left edge. While there, add a horizontal rule between wrapped rows so the 2×2 mobile layout still reads as one scoreboard.

Clean the working tree before the next deploy. `git status` reports ` M src/dashboard.ts` with 2013 lines against 1578 at HEAD — 435 uncommitted lines duplicating the whole KB block (kbRegistry/uploadZone/vKb each defined twice). In browser JS the later definition silently wins, and `fly deploy` is pre-authorized, so this would ship behaviour that was never reviewed; neither tsc nor the delivery gate can see it. Live is currently clean (one copy of each function). Either commit the intended change deliberately or `git checkout -- src/dashboard.ts`, then re-verify the served payload.

Delete the orphaned `uploadZone()` (dashboard.ts:915-922 at HEAD; zero call sites), and decide the create-a-service path it used to carry: either add a compact «أضف خدمة» action to the KB list header, or record that services are seeded-only for now. Today the portal can only manage the six hardcoded services.

Make the product page tell one story about readiness. The ring says «92% جاهزية معرفة المساعد» (from the seeded score) while the chip says «بانتظار ملف المعرفة» and the file row says «مطلوب» (from the uploaded doc). Either relabel the ring «جاهزية المعرفة المدمجة» or drive both indicators from the same signal.

Replace the transliteration «ساندبوكس» (3 occurrences, incl. the campaign-launch sticky bar) with «البيئة التجريبية», and the calques «المنتجات المدمجة» / «المعرفة الأساسية المدمجة» with «الخدمات المُعرَّفة مسبقًا» / «المعرفة الأساسية المضمَّنة».

Settle the operator-UI address policy in one pass. Recommended: nominal labels and captions, imperatives only on buttons. «ارفع ملفك أعلاه» → «ارفع الملف أعلاه»; «من أعمدة ملفك» → «من أعمدة الملف»; «قائمتك كما هي» → «القائمة كما هي»; «موافقتك البشرية على الإرسال» → «الموافقة البشرية على الإرسال»; «ويصلك تنبيه واتساب مباشرة» → «ويصل تنبيه واتساب مباشرة»; «اضغط أي حملة لفتح لوحتها» → «لكل حملة لوحتها الخاصة».

Name rate columns as rates. dashboard.ts:495 «مشاهدة» → «نسبة المشاهدة», «ردود» → «نسبة الردود» (matching the campaign-detail screen); align the CSV header at :523 to the same names so the export and the screen agree.

Pick one numeral system and add a single fmtNum() helper. Recommended: Latin digits everywhere ("ar-SA-u-nu-latn") since percentages, phone numbers and the funnel already use them — currently 13 sites use "ar-SA" (Arabic-Indic) and 6 use the Latin override, producing «4» in a stat card directly above «(٤)» in its own filter chip.

Re-capture the stale visual evidence at the reviewed commit. copy-home/kmon/kmondet/profile.png were taken 08:13:31–08:13:47, before f811a32 (08:14:46) and c4dbd29 (08:18:10), and all four show the pre-fix «فسار» wordmark. Only copy-wizard.png, the 375/768 sets and the three copy-kbprod captures are commit-true.

Apply the campaigns table the same treatment 8a599dc gave the product-page chips: give «الحملة» the flexible column width plus ellipsis and a full-name `title`, so two launches are distinguishable without opening them (3 of 5 rows currently ellipsize while «الحالة» holds slack).
Remove the decorative emoji that returned to operator chips: «ملف تعريفي 📎» (×2), «الملف مضمّن 📎», «🔔» on the alerts line — use the existing SVG icon set or nothing. ✓ and ✕ are functional and stay.

Close the plural-address loophole in the agent prompt. agent.ts:190 «… استخدم صيغة جمع مهنية، أو الاسم الأول للشخص عند توفره وباعتدال.» → «… خاطبه بصيغة الجمع دائمًا، ويمكن إضافة اسمه الأول عند توفره وباعتدال دون التحول إلى صيغة المفرد.» Then run ONE sandbox transcript to a team number and spot-check it per CLAUDE.md §3 — no post-rewrite transcript exists yet, so the agent half of this change is currently unproven (the transcripts in copy-profile.png predate the rewrite and show exactly the mixed register this loophole allows).
Update the stale header comment at agent.ts:9-15 — «light emoji» and «momentum-driven consultative closer» now contradict the prompt they document.
agent.ts:98 typo: «ننّفذ» → «ننفّذ» (shadda belongs on the ف, not the first ن).

Label parallelism: insights.ts:57 «ردّ على حملة» → «الردّ على حملة»; :60 «استلم الملف التعريفي» → «استلام الملف التعريفي»; LOSS_TAXONOMY «لا استجابة» → «عدم الاستجابة» and «طلب التواصل مع مختص» → «… مع مختص المبيعات». On the product-page scoreboard, make the four cells one grammatical shape once M4 renames them.

Widen dataSignature() from counts to a cheap content digest for winloss.loss_causes[0].cause, each campaign's status, and each contact's outcome; and replace the summed contact scalar with a joined per-contact string so an increment and a decrement in the same tick cannot cancel. Everything operator-critical is already covered — this closes the narrow stale-analytics window.

Home KPI label «وصلت الرسائل إلى الجهات» → «الرسائل الواصلة» (its four siblings are 1–3 word noun phrases); fix the nested guillemets in «…تظهر «فشل الإرسال» بشفافية»; settle the 768px chip wrap in the scoreboard footer band; drop one of the two stacked title/subtitle pairs on the campaigns screen.

user_model_updates: 2026-08-12 R35 [stated, reference artifact]: «the language is weak» + supplied HIS OWN approved WhatsApp template as the standard. → Rule 3 (briefs by concrete reference artifact) gets its strongest confirmation yet and now extends beyond visual design to LANGUAGE: his correction arrives as a specimen of the thing done right, and «follow this» means extract the rules and apply them everywhere, not paste the specimen in one place. Fifth briefs-by-artifact signal (R17, R21, R27-R30, R32, R35) — Rule 3 is firm.

2026-08-12 R35 [stated]: he audits REGISTER, not grammar — the template's load-bearing features are enterprise plural address (منشأتكم/لدعمكم/معكم), verb-led openings (ارتقِ/يُمكّن/يساهم), operational-outcome benefits (تسريع الإجراءات، تقليل العمل اليدوي) and a collaborative close (يسعدنا التنسيق معكم) instead of a call to action. → Add to Vocabulary: «اللغة ضعيفة» = the register is off (marketing tone, casual address, inconsistent terms), not that the Arabic is ungrammatical.

2026-08-12 R35 [stated, mid-round]: «make the UI better» + a screenshot of the product page, where his objection was COMPOSITION — the name alone in one card, the number floating in another, the CTA stranded across whitespace, four verdict chips as an unordered row. → Second composition-specific signal (with R32's «not implementing anything correctly» + reference screenshots): he reads a screen as a RECORD and expects related facts to occupy one visual object. One more recurrence promotes a rule: «information that belongs to one entity must sit in one container — scattered cards read as unfinished to him.»

2026-08-12 R35 [stated]: he asked for the Cairo font and, separately, noticed the portal visibly churning every 5 seconds. → Third signal (with R27's «fires don't make sense» and R32's «design is horrible») that he reports RENDERING and MOTION defects unprompted, at the same severity as missing features. Promote to a rule next round: «visual/rendering defects are functional defects to him — a repaint, a font, an ambiguous glyph blocks acceptance as hard as a broken endpoint.»

2026-08-12 R35 [CPO process learning, not a user preference]: a mechanical copy pass that skips strings for containing markup leaves a silent unproofread bucket — here ~230 of 462 entries, and 100% of this round's language defects lived inside it. Copy work must report coverage as «applied / skipped» and treat the skipped set as a required second pass, not residue. Logged as a proposed playbook amendment for `scripts/orbit-memory review` (third round whose change-order theme is «the tool's coverage gap became the product's defect»).

2026-08-12 R35 [observed, design-language rule for Massar]: tashkeel that carries meaning is unreliable at UI sizes in Cairo — the wordmark fatha read as «فسار» at brand weight (correctly fixed by removal) and the damma on «حُجز/أُرسل» is illegible at button size (M6, still open). Never let a diacritic be the only thing distinguishing two meanings in the UI.

2026-08-12 R35 [CPO process learning]: read the COMMITTED tree, never the working tree — my first pass read `src/dashboard.ts` from disk and would have mis-attributed a 435-line uncommitted duplication to the reviewed commit. `git show <sha>:<path>` is the only valid source for a commit-bound verdict, and a dirty-tree check belongs in every envelope while `fly deploy` stays pre-authorized.
user_impact_summary:
قلتَ إنّ اللغة ضعيفة، وأعطيتنا قالبك المعتمد ليكون المرجع، ثم طلبتَ في منتصف الجولة تحسين واجهة صفحة الخدمة. أربعة من خمسة طلبات تمّت وتحققتُ منها بنفسي: القالب صار فعليًا الرسالة الافتراضية لكل حملة بمتغيّر {product} وتذييل «حلول تكامل للقطاع الصحي»؛ ولغة مساعد المبيعات أُعيدت كتابتها بصوتك — «يُمكّن منشأتكم من إصدار الإجازات المرضية وإدارتها إلكترونيًا…» — بصيغة الجمع المؤسسي وأفعال قوية في البداية وقيمة تشغيلية محددة بلا مبالغة؛ وخطّ Cairo مُفعّل ويظهر بوضوح، وشعار «مسار» صار يُقرأ صحيحًا بعد إزالة الفتحة التي كانت تجعله يبدو «فسار»؛ وقسم «محادثات خارج الحملات» أُزيل؛ وتوقّف اهتزاز الشاشة كل خمس ثوانٍ (تتبّعتُ كل مسار تحديث يهمّ المشغّل واحدًا واحدًا — الرسائل، حالات التسليم، التسليم اليدوي، تسجيل النتيجة — وكلها تُحدِّث الشاشة فورًا، والساعة وحدها تستمر).

وصفحة الخدمة تحسّنت فعلًا وبالضبط حيث اشتكيت: الاسم والحالة ونسبة الجاهزية وزر «أطلق حملة بهذه الخدمة ←» صاروا في صفٍّ واحد ينتهي بالإجراء، والأرقام الأربعة صارت لوحة واحدة بدل شرائح متناثرة، وأسماء الحملات لم تعد تُقطع في منتصف الكلمة، والمربعات المتقطّعة العريضة استُبدلت بصفّي ملفات مضغوطين تحت سطر أراه من أفضل ما كُتب في المنتج: «ما يرسله المساعد للعميل، وما يقرأه ليبيع».

ومع ذلك لم أقبل هذه الجولة، لثلاثة أسباب محدّدة. الأول أنّ طلبك الأساسي — اللغة — لم يكتمل: أُعيدت كتابة ٢٣٢ نصًا من أصل ٤٦٢، وبقي نحو ٢٣٠ نصًا دون مراجعة لأنها مدمجة بوسوم HTML، وكل خلل لغوي وجدتُه اليوم كان داخل هذه المجموعة تحديدًا — كلمة خاطئة تظهر في الرئيسية ولوحة الحملات («الأرقام تتحدّث لحظيًا» و«العدد يتحدّث فورًا» والصواب «تُحدَّث»)، ومصطلح واحد بأسماء متعددة: «الخدمة» مقابل «منتج» بنسبة ٩ إلى ٢٥، ومجموعة الجهات تُسمّى بأربعة أسماء، والصفقة صارت تُسمّى بثلاثة («مكتسبة/غير مكتسبة»، «مكتسبة/خاسرة»، والآن «مكتملة/لم تُغلق» في الصفحة الجديدة). وما زالت العبارتان اللتان نصّ عليهما مرجع الصوت بالاسم — «ما يستحق وقتك الآن» و«افتح ←» — في الرئيسية كما هما.

والثاني خطأ في لوحة الأرقام الجديدة: الخط الفاصل مرسوم على الحافة المنطقية الخاطئة، فلا يوجد فاصل بين «حملات الخدمة» و«صفقات مكتملة» — يظهران كخانة واحدة عريضة — بينما يقف خط زائد على حافة البطاقة اليسرى. تحققتُ منه في الشيفرة وبالعين في الصور الثلاث. إصلاحه كلمة واحدة، لكنه يُفقد اللوحة تماسكها الذي بُنيت من أجله.

والثالث أهمّها عمليًا: نسخة العمل المحلية تحتوي ٤٣٥ سطرًا غير محفوظة تُكرّر كتلة صفحة المعرفة كاملة (ثلاث دوال معرّفة مرتين). النسخة المنشورة سليمة الآن، لكن بما أنّ النشر مُصرّح به تلقائيًا، فإن أي نشر من هذه النسخة سيرفع سلوكًا لم يراجعه أحد — ولا الـ build ولا بوابة الجودة تستطيع رؤيته. نظّفها قبل أي نشر قادم.

المطلوب: ثمانية إصلاحات إلزامية محدّدة بالسطر والنص البديل، وليست إعادة عمل. اللغة التي كُتبت جيدة فعلًا، والناقص أن تصل إلى النصف الذي لم تصله الأداة.
